description:
Promotions and combos. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_promotions: List ALL promotions/discounts of the site (every page is fetched for you).
- search_promotions: Search/filter ALL promotions (every page): by keyword, type, time status (coming_soon/in_progress/finished), active flag.
- get_promotion: Get full promotion details by ID: name, type, schedule, discount rules, coupon settings, items, bonus products, etc.
- get_promotion_items: Get products/variations/categories attached to a promotion.
- get_active_promotions: Get all currently active promotions (is_activated=true and within start_time/end_time range)
- list_combos: List all combo/bundle products of the site.
- get_combo_items: Get items (products/variations) and bonus products that compose a combo.

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

include_guide.description: Include promotion type reference guide [list_promotions, list_combos]

type.description: Filter by type: normal, same_price, coupon, coupon_id_multiple_times, discount_by_coupon_id, prom… [search_promotions]
